metadata.title: Nvidia and AMD continue to slide as chip stocks weaken - MarketWatch

content.text:
2 hours ago
Nvidia and AMD continue to slide as chip stocks weaken
Fears over sales restrictions to China continue to hit Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices in premarket trade. Nvidia shares slumped 2% as AMD stock dropped 6%. More broadly, the VanEck Semiconductor ETF fell 3%, as Marvell Technology fell 4% and Intel stock fell 5%.
Piper Sandler chief global economist Nancy Lazar said South Korea and Taiwan provide good leading signals for U.S. tech activity. "Both are showing signs of cooling from clearly unsustainable growth trajectories," she said.
